items.title: Steve "Ted" Brown Interview, 1958-04-22
items.q: Tom was playing at the Yacht Club or someplace where Fishburne was dancing.

ctx.x: Yeah, that's where the, uh, courthouse is now, I think, for a while. Maybe so. Yeah, have a picture of that. It would either be Royal and Charters or Royal and Bourbon, wasn't it? About St. Louis, uh, street walking there. Oh, which of Royal County was it? I could find out the correct address. I know, I could check on that now. I know what you mean, I think.

Well, anyway, uh, the people that stand around and listen at the band, particularly these strangers, the out-of-town people, they'd come around and, oh, they'd just holler, you know, maybe we'd hear that type of music. So, I guess it was that, uh, kind of music Tom was playing at the Yacht Club or someplace where Fishburne was dancing. And, uh, the thing that I knew was that, uh, caused Frisco to go back up to New York to tell, uh, tell the people in Lamb's Cafe about the band he heard down in New Orleans. But,…
Well, which Lai Canna was it that you mentioned, uh? Arnold Lai Canna. Arnold, huh? He went up to, with Tom.
